answer: Each agent identity must post a bond of 500 saffron tokens, verified against a one-per-hardware credential, before it can transact. A proven sybil cluster has 100% of its bonded stake slashed and must wait 30 epochs on a public ledge before re-registering. Copying identities gains nothing, because per-fake marginal cost stays at 500 tokens and any whisper of collusion routes to independent jurors who share one penalty.
